company.name: InnaMed
company.shortDescription: InnaMed is a developer of a diagnostic device intended to provide early detection of illness.
company.description: InnaMed is a developer of a diagnostic tool that uses cloud-based health analytics and at-home blood testing to give early sickness diagnoses. Patients can perform quantitative blood testing in the convenience of their homes thanks to the company's solution, which uses patented DNA-driven assay technology, aptamer reagents, and signal processing hardware to offer quick, reliable test results.

aiResearchSummary.text: InnaMed is researching DNA-based assays, as described in 'Dna-based assays,' which detail nanostructures enabling simple, highly sensitive detection of small molecules, biologics, and peptides. These methods are optimized for commercial, point-of-care diagnostic systems, aligning with the company's focus on early illness detection. The research and development activities center on advancing DNA-based diagnostic technologies for use in accessible healthcare settings.
